findings.question: Official gazette and legislation: Authentic text of laws and regulations
findings.quote: Od tega datuma bodo vse objave dostopne izključno v elektronski obliki na spletišču Pravnega informacijskega sistema Republike Slovenije (PISRS), tiskana izdaja pa se z 28. 2. 2026 ukinja.
findings.quote_english: From that date, all publications will be available exclusively in electronic form on the website of the Legal Information System of the Republic of Slovenia (PISRS), and the printed edition is discontinued as of 28. 2. 2026.
findings.value: Pravni informacijski sistem Republike Slovenije (PISRS) (Legal Information System of the Republic of Slovenia), sole publication platform of the Uradni list RS
findings.title: O glasilu
findings.note: From 1 March 2026 the gazette appears only on PISRS, and uradni-list.si content is marked archival. The statute sources printed from uradni-list.si for SI are therefore now archival copies.

review.reason: The quote says all official gazette publications are now electronic only, on the PISRS website.
